summary.text: James Burke is an independent who sought Indiana's 8th Congressional District seat and describes himself as a Terre Haute native running a social-media-only campaign without fundraising. Ballotpedia states he will not appear on the November 3, 2026 ballot.

paragraphs.text: Earned a high school diploma from Terre Haute South High School, completed a carpenter's apprenticeship, and attended Western Governors University.
